# ex: assigneeType via ValueSpec path
ex {
	var x int
	F(x) -> G(x)
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F(x int) int { return x }
func G(x int) int { return x + 1 }

var A int = F(1)
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,4 +3,4 @@
 func F(x int) int { return x }
 func G(x int) int { return x + 1 }

-var A int = F(1)
+var A int = G(1)
